Subject: Request to add 3 new projects and extra keys

Soojin —

Quick note from our side: after the pilot success, we want to onboard three additional internal projects (SearchAssist, IntakeForm AI, and BillingRerank) over the next quarter. That will require:
- 6 additional API keys (one per project + 3 for sandbox/dev)

Raj —

Fantastic to hear the pilot went well. We can absolutely support adding the three projects and provisioning the additional keys. High-level options:

1) 12-month amendment (preferred for pricing): add the 3 projects, 6 keys, and a reserved burst capacity buffer (2x) for rollout windows. 8% platform credit on monthly usage for the first 3 months to offset ramp.
2) Short-term addendum (90 days): flexible capacity, no credits, higher overage costs.

I attached a draft amendment and a quick usage forecast to illustrate the expected token footprint. If you’re ok, I’ll loop in Laura (contracts) and Ben (capacity planning) to confirm timelines and produce a DocuSign-ready amendment by EOW.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm which projects to enroll (looks like the three named above)
- Confirm target rollout windows (approx dates)
- Sign amendment to schedule provisioning and key issuance

Cheers,
Soojin Lee

Subject: RE: Request to add 3 new projects and extra keys (contracts/term)

Soojin —

Reviewed the draft. A few contract notes:
- We can extend the current term by 12 months; the amendment will reference original PO and extend the SOW accordingly.
- For the 8% credit, we'll structure it as a one-time credit applied over the first three invoice cycles; needs an approval line item for finance.
- Add a clause for temporary burst capacity — define "burst window" (max 4 weeks per project within first 90 days) and a soft cap for sustained utilization.

I'll prepare tracked changes and route to legal for a quick sign-off. Ben — can you confirm capacity availability for the windows Raj referenced?

—Laura
Director, Contracts | Redwood Inference
